game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Input Interpreter: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Read simulated input() answers from villagers, cast them, and respond correctly. Each round, fire sprites strike the forge anvil, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trust value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the forge anvil from fire sprites in Geyser Flats: keep the trust meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: trust drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Input Interpreter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Input Interpreter' (Week 2 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Geyser Flats'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trust changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 59 seconds while trust > 0.
